facts.fact: 本章视角人物是 Saskia：她从 2020 年第一次见到 Roger 就恨他，恨他的偏执、窥探、摄像头与自大。
facts.anchor: She has hated Roger since the moment she met him in 2020.

facts.fact: Saskia 像垒球训练里那样完成挥棒，铝制球棒打在 Roger 后脑，他像上钩的鱼一样甩头、摔倒。
facts.anchor: She completes her swing, just like they taught her in softball

facts.fact: Roger 想站起来时她再打一棒正中嘴部，他仰面倒地四肢乱蹬；此前她已把他的手机踢飞到房间另一头。
facts.anchor: she hits him again, this time right in the mouth

facts.fact: Saskia 见 Lucy 目击后心想“又来了”：梦游、种子、刀，她早知道事情在重演。
facts.anchor: The sleepwalking, the seeds, the knife.

facts.fact: 她意识到自己要伤害的从来不是 Lucy；她不后悔打 Roger，只怕 Lucy 终于看清她是怪物。
facts.anchor: But it wasn’t Lucy she was meant to hurt.

facts.fact: Saskia 把球棒轻放到地上再一脚踢开，怕吓到 Lucy，并反复问 Lucy 是否还好。
facts.anchor: Saskia gently places the bat on the floor

facts.fact: 被问是否没事时 Lucy 只答“不”，声音又高又像孩子，然后走进卧室。
facts.anchor: “No,” Lucy says, her voice high and childlike.

facts.fact: 章末落点：Saskia 以为全完了，Lucy 却捧着那尊大理石半身像重新出现。
facts.anchor: Saskia is certain that all is lost until Lucy reappears holding the marble bust.
